text: At the Battle of Sudoměř in 1420, Jan Žižka deployed wagon forts to decisively defeat royalist cavalry forces.
The wagon fort (vozová hradba) was an armored mobile wall consisting of standard peasant carts chained together to defend infantry.
In 1421, at the Battle of Kutná Hora, Žižka executed the first documented tactical breakthrough of a cavalry encirclement using mobile wagon fort artillery.
